title: The Halloween Tape
description: This is a Halloween themed beat tape, made using a huge library of Halloween and horror movie samples.

title: Walk With Us
description:
Black Rhino presents the 'Walk With Us' beat-tape compilation in partnership with Bucharest's Creative Quarter and with the help of the Beats & Pieces community. Launched as a competition in the winter of 2023, Walk With Us was assembled after carefully selecting amongst 130 entries.

This collective album is a musical journey and a testament to community spirit. It's an invitation to explore the urban space while immersing in the tape, presenting diverse musical visions of the city from different producers.

title: Electrofantul - 11 Thoughts

title: Plastel - FeedMeBeatz

title: The Christmas Tape
description: This is a Christmas themed beat tape, a compilation of beats made with samples taken from Elena Mîndru Quintet's amazing album called 'Romanian Christmas Stories' in which they created jazz reinterpretations of traditional Romanian carols.

title: The Miles Davis Tape
